validity_domain.condition: This card applies only to the lambda_phi=0 special case discussed separately from the pNGB branch.
The local text reports allowed DM mass from a few TeV to about 70 TeV after relic-density, XENONnT, and perturbativity considerations.

global.description: The paper states that for lambda_phi=0 the global U(1)_X dark symmetry is no longer spontaneously broken and the dark matter is no longer pNGB.
The relic-density discussion assumes thermal freeze-out through scalar annihilation channels.

dominant_uncertainties: This is a special parameter limit and should not be merged with the pNGB branch.
